chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, from his father, from his forefathers عليهم السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:

There are three regarding whom I do not know which of them is greater in sin: the one who walks with the جنازة without a cloak, or the one who says, ‘Stop,’ or the one who says, ‘Seek forgiveness for him; may Allah forgive you.’

key_terms.أَعْظَمُ جُرْمًا: Greater in sin or more serious in wrongdoing
key_terms.اسْتَغْفِرُوا: Seek forgiveness; an exhortation directed to others
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: The funeral procession or bier of the deceased
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ رِدَاءٍ: Without an outer cloak or proper covering
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: Three categories or persons mentioned for condemnation
key_terms.قِفُوا: Stop; an instruction said during the funeral procession

ai.seo_question: What actions during a funeral procession are condemned in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns certain improper practices and utterances connected to accompanying a funeral procession. It highlights the gravity of violating proper funeral etiquette and warns that some common behaviors may constitute serious sin.
